text: {"assertions":["A flaky CI pipeline job in build/ci/pipeline.yml was debugged on 2026-07-09.","The flaky job could be reproduced by rerunning the same commit ten times, with one job failing on a minority of runs.","The issue only manifested for users in negative UTC offsets.","The root cause was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime.","The fix made all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge in PR #1104 on branch fix/flaky-job-1.","After the fix, throughput increased by 65% to 821 requests per second.","The pipeline is written in YAML with a pipeline replay job used for covering the fix."]}
